zid000001.name: Survival by treatment
zid000001.notes: Days to death (code 1) or censoring (code 0: alive at day 180 or lost to follow-up), 24 patients per arm, one per row. Simulated exponential survival times. Kaplan-Meier curves, the log-rank test, the test for trend and hazard ratios.

zid000007.name: Adverse events
zid000007.notes: Patients with and without an adverse event in each arm (100 per arm). Made-up counts. Fisher’s exact test with the relative risk and odds ratio.

zid000012.name: Response by dose
zid000012.notes: Responders and non-responders at three doses, 50 patients each. Made-up counts. Chi-square test, the chi-square test for trend (Cochran-Armitage), Cramér’s V, and every pair of doses compared (Fisher’s exact test on each pair, Bonferroni-corrected).

zid000018.name: Patient cohort
zid000018.notes: 120 simulated patients: age, BMI, sex (Male = 1, and as text), dose (mg) and treatment arm (text), systolic blood pressure, cholesterol, response (1 = responder), days of follow-up and death (1) or censoring (0) at one year. Multiple linear regression of SBP (also with sex and arm as categorical predictors, an interaction and predicted SBP), logistic regression of response, Cox regression of survival (numeric and categorical), multifactor ANOVA of SBP by sex and arm, Kaplan-Meier curves by arm, and PCA of the continuous variables.

zid000068.name: Logistic regression (response by dose and sex)

zid000069.name: Cox regression by arm and sex

zid000073.name: Multifactor ANOVA (SBP by sex and arm)

zid000076.name: Biomarker
zid000076.notes: A serum biomarker (ng/mL) in 40 controls and 30 patients. Simulated lognormal data. The ROC curve shows how well it separates them (area under the curve with its CI) and the sensitivity and specificity at each cut-off.

zid000084.name: Sample size (from the pilot biomarker data)

zid000087.name: Method comparison
zid000087.notes: Glucose (mg/dL) of 40 samples measured by a lab analyser and a point-of-care device (each row one sample). Simulated with a small proportional bias. Bland-Altman plot of the differences against the averages, with the bias and 95% limits of agreement, and the correlation.

zid000100.name: Pea phenotypes
zid000100.notes: Mendel’s dihybrid cross (556 peas), the example of Prism’s guide. Compared with the 9:3:3:1 ratio by the chi-square goodness-of-fit test (P = 0.93: no evidence against the ratio).

zid000103.name: Hospital visits
zid000103.notes: Hospital visits in one year of 80 simulated patients (a Poisson count) with age and smoking (1 = smoker). Poisson regression: the rate ratios per year of age and for smokers.
